definitions.explanation: Marks the ending point in time. {五時|ごじ}まで{働|はたら}く (work until 5 o'clock), {明日|あした}まで (until tomorrow).
Marks the ending point in space. {駅|えき}まで{歩|ある}く (walk to the station).
Emphasizes an extreme or unexpected extent. {彼|かれ}まで{来|き}た (even he came), {子供|こども}まで{知|し}っている (even children know).
Indicates the degree to which something extends. {泣|な}くまで{笑|わら}った (laughed until [I] cried).

particle_contrasts.explanation: まで emphasizes extent/continuation to endpoint; に marks a specific point

examples.made_note: まで emphasizes duration up to endpoint

key_points: まで = extent/duration up to a point
までに = 'by' (deadline): {五時|ごじ}までに (by 5 o'clock)

particle_contrasts.explanation: Both can mean 'even,' but まで emphasizes extent while も indicates inclusion

common_mistakes.mistake: Confusing まで with までに
common_mistakes.context: {五時|ごじ}まで vs {五時|ごじ}までに
common_mistakes.explanation: まで = until 5 (continuous); までに = by 5 (deadline)

common_mistakes.mistake: Using まで when に is more appropriate
common_mistakes.incorrect: {三時|さんじ}まで{始|はじ}まる
common_mistakes.explanation: Use に for specific point events; まで for duration/extent

common_mistakes.mistake: Using も instead of まで for 'even' (surprising extent)
common_mistakes.context: When emphasizing an unexpected extreme, まで is stronger
common_mistakes.explanation: {先生|せんせい}まで{間違|まちが}えた (even the teacher made a mistake) vs {先生|せんせい}も{間違|まちが}えた (the teacher also made a mistake)

notes:
まで marks an endpoint or limit — in time, space, or degree.

FUNCTIONS:
- Time endpoint: the action runs up to that moment — ⟦{五時|ごじ}→時：09869_ji⟧まで⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧
- Spatial endpoint: motion or measurement reaches that far — ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧まで⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧
- "Even": the situation extends to a surprising case — ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧まで⟦{間違|まちが}えた→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧
- Degree: after a plain verb, the point something is carried to — ⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧まで⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧

KEY PATTERNS:
- ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧...まで: from...to — ⟦{九時|くじ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{五時|ごじ}→時：09869_ji⟧まで
- まで⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: by (deadline) — ⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧まで⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧
- Plain verb + まで: until someone does something — ⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧まで

まで VS までに:
This is the commonest learner error with the particle, and the test is what kind of verb follows.
- まで takes an action that continues up to the limit: ⟦{五時|ごじ}→時：09869_ji⟧まで⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (wait until 5)
- までに takes a one-time action completed at some point before the limit: ⟦{五時|ごじ}→時：09869_ji⟧まで⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (submit by 5)
- Plain ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ marks a point rather than a limit: ⟦{五時|ごじ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧ (finish at 5)

'EVEN' USAGE:
As "even", まで is stronger than ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ simply adds a case, while まで presents it as a surprising extreme.

VERB FORM BEFORE まで:
A verb before まで stays in the plain non-past form whatever the tense of the main clause: ⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧まで⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧ (I laughed until I cried), never ×{泣|な}いたまで. The same holds for までに.
